instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Industrial bakery producing frozen dough and par-baked products for supermarket chains and food service distributors. Output of 15,000 units per day across 4 production lines. Key challenges are shelf-life extension through modified atmosphere packaging and reducing energy consumption in blast freezing, all while strictly adhering to stringent FDA and local health standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: We attempted to introduce a weekly innovation brainstorming session across departments, but attendance dropped rapidly after the first month. Participants felt the sessions generated interesting ideas but had no clear path to execution or budget. The initiative faded without producing any tangible outcome.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount—we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements in our second-largest market will force us to re-architect our cloud infrastructure within 12 months to maintain operating licenses. This is a non-discretionary technical project that will consume significant engineering capacity. Innovation initiatives must be sequenced around this mandatory work or find ways to turn the migration itself into a modernization opportunity.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Blast Freezing Cycle Optimization via IoT Monitoring
opportunities.rationale: Implementing low-cost temperature monitoring and automated control systems on existing blast freezers can directly target energy consumption waste, aligning perfectly with the efficiency goal. This is a relatively low-risk technical upgrade that leverages existing hardware.

first_actions: Identify the single highest energy-consuming freezer unit.
Invest in inexpensive IoT sensors for temperature and cycle duration monitoring.
Run a 30-day pilot program comparing current vs. optimized cycle energy usage.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Dev time (10 hours total) allocated by generalist developers
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce energy consumption per unit produced by 8% within the pilot phase.
milestones: Q1: Sensor installation and baseline data collection completed.
Q2: Optimization strategy defined based on pilot data.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation for Order Entry and Inventory Check
opportunities.rationale: Focusing on automating manual data entry and the subsequent inventory reconciliation process addresses operational waste. This incremental change minimizes human error, a key efficiency driver in micro manufacturing.

first_actions: Implement basic scripted integration between existing ERP/POS and inventory database.
Train core staff on new simplified data input protocols.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Time allocation for 2 developers (40 hours total)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce order processing cycle time by 15% and decrease inventory discrepancy rate to <1%.
milestones: Month 3: Successful integration of the core ordering system.
Month 6: Full deployment across all four production lines.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance Model for Key Production Equipment
opportunities.rationale: Developing a predictive maintenance model using simple machine learning on sensor data gathered during the energy optimization pilot could drastically reduce unexpected downtime and associated operational losses. While technically ambitious, we will keep this bold by focusing strictly on low-cost sensors (vibration/temp) rather than complex AI systems.

first_actions: Source basic vibration sensors for the most critical machinery.
Use existing data to label 'failure' vs. 'normal' operational states.
Develop a simple threshold-based alert system rather than complex ML.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Consultant time for 50 hours (focused on data strategy)
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease unplanned machine downtime by 25% in the first year.
milestones: Q3: Data pipeline established and initial anomaly detection model trained.
Year 1 End: Model deployed for predictive alerts on three critical assets.

next_steps.action: Define detailed requirements and cost-benefit analysis for the Blast Freezing Cycle Optimization pilot.
Allocate specific engineering hours for Q1 automation workflow mapping, treating it as mandatory project work.
Establish a formal, documented process for incorporating customer feedback into the long-term strategy review.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on manual, informal processes leading to high operational waste.
Extremely constrained budget (3%) making large capital expenditures risky and difficult to justify.
Lack of dedicated R&D or innovation personnel forcing developers to juggle maintenance and projects.
